title: The demonic theater and submerged tunnel
content: It started with me walking along the backside of the school. At least I think it was the school. It could have also been a warehouse. I was following some people until we got to some stairs that went all the way to a single door. I followed them into this place and discovered it to be a theater. It was crowded with a ton of people. They were rowdy as hell. I felt like I didn't belong there and if they noticed me I would be in danger. I grabbed a hooded robe and put it on me. I sat down and noticed a group of people surrounding a blonde man who was in charge. He was in charge of this group and he seemed to become aware that there was an intruder. I tried to hide my face and that's when a girl that had been standing next to him came over to me. She had long dark brown hair and brown eyes. She was very pretty. She told me that I shouldn't be there, that I was too aware and that he could detect it. She pointed at the guy. As she tried leading me out of this theater, the guy noticed us. He yelled "Traitor" and then pointed at us. The girl led me out of this theater and we ended up in another theater. As we entered, the doors closed behind us and vanished. The walls seemed to be made of human flesh and muscles. Arteries, veins, could be seen pumping blood. This theater was filled with a mix of a few humans, but everything else...they were demons. All shapes, sizes. Some were cloaked. But they were all sitting or standing in this theater. On the stage were several other cloaked demons. All of them were chanting something. There were demonic faces coming out of the walls, their mouths grinning and grinding their fangs. Groups of cloaked figures started to come down the aisles. They were accompanied by these floating creatures. They resembled the Beholders from the D&D games. But a little different. They had many eyes. Suddenly, everyone stopped. The leader of the demons, who was on the stage, started to tell everyone that they had intruders. The beholder demons started to go around the theater looking for us. The girl leaned closer to me and said "We can get out of here if you know how". She said that everyone that was aware had the ability to open doorways that would get them to other places. They could simply just think about it and a portal would open up. We were then found by one of those things. The leader was yelling for it to bring us to him. I was so scared of being killed that I actually tried to punch it. But somehow I opened a portal. It was blue in color. The girl yelled to jump through even if we didn't know where we would end up. So we did. We landed in a tunnel. It was more like a hallway with bathroom tiles all over. They were a sky blue color. These tiles were all over the floor, ceiling and walls. We walked further down and came upon a pool of water. On the other side was an exit, but a gate blocked our path. The girl jumped into the water and I followed her. As she tried to go over to the gate she discovered there was a way to dive under and come out the other side. But there was a current that would not let us get near. I noticed something at the bottom of the pool. It was some kind of knob. So I dived under and turned it a bit. The water suddenly pulled us both towards the gated door. We were underwater and I could not swim or breathe. I was suffocating. It was horrible. But then we finally came out to a place we could crawl up. It was like a ramp. The tiles were still here but as we walked along the walls turned to rock. The ground turned to dirt. We exited out of the mouth of a cave and came out into a desert. I looked behind us and we appeared to be behind mountains. The clouds prevented me from seeing the tops of them. But as we walked into the desert, I looked back again and noticed various tall buildings in the distance, just above the smaller mountains. It looked like the mall or part of the school we had been at. The girl pointed towards what looked like an ocean in the distance so we made our way to it. But it seemed like it was going to take a while to get there. I woke up at this point.
